name: Hashtechy Chatbot
author: Hashtechy

sections.description:
Instant AI chatbot for WordPress with modern UI, analytics, and easy integration.

Key Features:

  • Modern chatbot UI
  • Easy integration using script
  • Real-time analytics
  • Lightweight and fast
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • No coding required

Perfect for:

  • Business websites
  • SaaS platforms
  • Customer support
  • Lead generation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hashtechy-chatbot directory, or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Hashtechy Chatbot Settings from the admin menu.
  4. Add your chatbot script URL or Bot ID.
  5. Save settings and the chatbot will appear on your website.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require coding knowledge?

No, the plugin works with simple configuration from the admin panel.

Can I use it with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Hashtechy Chatbot works with all WordPress themes.

Does it support mobile devices?

Yes, the chatbot is fully responsive and works on mobile, tablet and desktop.

Is the chatbot customizable?

Yes, you can customize chatbot settings and appearance.
